string.name: addon_verification_hint
string.value: Watch key, sequence numbers, chain and sync log

string.name: addon_sentence
string.value: FairWear is an add-on for HUAWEI Health users: with their permission it reads what HUAWEI Health already measures, scores it on the phone, and shares only a signed tier.

string.name: addon_reads_sentence
string.value: FairWear reads steps, resting heart rate, sleep, activity minutes, VO₂max, HRV and workouts from the last 90 days; it does not read location, ECG, blood pressure, SpO₂, weight or contacts; the only thing that leaves this phone is a signed A/B/C tier, and only when you share it.

string.name: addon_value_sentence
string.value: Your HUAWEI Health history becomes a signed A/B/C tier, scored on this phone.

string.name: addon_reads_short
string.value: Steps, heart rate, sleep and activity from the last 90 days

string.name: addon_never_reads_short
string.value: Location, ECG, blood pressure, SpO₂, weight, contacts

string.name: addon_leaves_short
string.value: Only a signed tier, and only when you share it

string.name: addon_privacy_settings_sentence
string.value: You can also end the connection in HUAWEI Health privacy settings.

string.name: addon_refused_body
string.value: No health data was read. Without your permission FairWear cannot calculate your Health Evidence Score, coverage or tier, and there is nothing to share.

string.name: addon_health_sim_sentence
string.value: Health Sim stands in for HUAWEI Health on this emulator.

string.name: addon_health_sim_asking_body
string.value: Health Sim shows its own consent screen. FairWear does not reproduce it and gets nothing until you allow it there.

string.name: addon_health_sim_reads_sentence
string.value: Reads the simulated data Health Sim handed over after your consent. Health Sim stands in for HUAWEI Health on this emulator.

string.name: addon_disconnected_body
string.value: Health data held in memory was cleared and the tier is hidden. Connecting again asks for your consent again.

string.name: report_preview_line
string.value: Score engine not connected — preview values

string.name: report_today_note
string.value: Enters your score when the day closes. Your score uses completed days only.

string.name: report_disclaimer
string.value: HES is deterministic rules, not a medical device. Weights and curves are prototype assumptions, not clinically tested.

string.name: report_no_score_body
string.value: We need more completed days before we can score fairly. A low score is never shown instead.

string.name: report_share_needs_score
string.value: Share is available once you have a score.

string.name: persona_sheet_note
string.value: Fixed preview data, for the demo only

string.name: report_next_step_sentence
string.value: This screen arrives in the next step.

string.name: evidence_flag_line
string.value: Selective non-wear: flagged → no benefit this month

string.name: evidence_calendar_hint
string.value: Tap a day to see what the watch recorded.

string.name: evidence_appeal_note
string.value: An appeal does not change this day or your score. In this demo it stays on this phone.

string.name: why_missing_note
string.value: Missing data never lowers your score. It only lowers coverage.

string.name: why_assumptions
string.value: Weights, curves and minimum counts are prototype product assumptions, not clinically tested.

string.name: live_note
string.value: Shown, not scored. Close the day turns today's steps into a completed day; the heart rate is never stored.

string.name: demo_controls_note
string.value: Close the day adds today as a completed day and recalculates the score. Reset returns this persona to its starting month.

string.name: persona_sheet_note_engine
string.value: Scripted demo personas, scored by the same rules

string.name: share_intro
string.value: Show this code to your partner

string.name: share_intro_no_score
string.value: There is no code to show yet

string.name: share_not_in_code
string.value: Not in this code: your score, coverage, flags, sick days or any readings. The partner can use it once.

string.name: ledger_note
string.value: Every code this phone has shown, newest first, with its exact text. The app has no network permission: a code leaves the phone only when someone scans it.

string.name: ledger_empty
string.value: No code has been shown yet.

string.name: share_no_code_sentence
string.value: No code yet. Without a score nothing is signed and nothing leaves this phone.

string.name: partner_band_note
string.value: This screen plays the partner. The emulator has no camera, so the code is handed over inside the app.

string.name: partner_use_code_label
string.value: Use the code from this phone

string.name: partner_no_code_on_phone
string.value: No code has been shown on this phone yet. Open Share first.

string.name: partner_cheat_needs_code
string.value: Use the code from this phone first.

string.name: partner_attempt_again
string.value: The same code, a second time

string.name: addon_status_demo
string.value: Demo mode: nothing is read from HUAWEI Health in this build.

string.name: addon_status_unavailable
string.value: HUAWEI Health is unavailable in this build.

string.name: addon_status_not_connected
string.value: Not connected: FairWear has no permission to read from HUAWEI Health.

string.name: partner_attempt_tampered
string.value: The same code with the tier changed to %s

string.name: report_unlock_step_heart_rate
string.value: Turn on continuous heart rate monitoring in HUAWEI Health

string.name: report_unlock_step_trusleep
string.value: Turn on TruSleep in HUAWEI Health

string.name: evidence_day_note_compliant
string.value: This day counts towards your month.

string.name: evidence_day_note_short
string.value: The watch was worn too little for this day to count.

string.name: evidence_day_note_suspicious
string.value: A break on this day counts as suspicious.

string.name: evidence_day_note_sick
string.value: A sick day. It is left out of the month and never sent to your partner.

string.name: evidence_day_note_no_watch
string.value: No watch yet: there is no record from the watch for this day.

string.name: why_how_line_curve
string.value: Each measure is scored from 0 to 100 on a fixed curve, from completed days only.

string.name: why_how_line_average
string.value: Your score is the weighted average of the measures that have enough data. A missing measure is left out; it is never counted as zero.

string.name: why_how_line_tiers
string.value: Tier A starts at %d, tier B at %d.

string.name: why_how_line_coverage
string.value: Coverage is the share of the full set of measures that has enough data.

string.name: why_how_line_core
string.value: Without one of the core measures there is no score at all, never a low one.

string.name: consent_platform_placeholder_title
string.value: Here HUAWEI Health shows its own authorization screen.

string.name: consent_platform_placeholder_body
string.value: FairWear does not reproduce that screen. The two buttons below stand in for the answer the user gives there.

string.name: consent_platform_unavailable
string.value: HUAWEI Health is unavailable in this build: access to health data through Health Service Kit has to be granted to the app by Huawei, and FairWear does not have it yet.

string.name: consent_platform_not_requested
string.value: Not requested: location, ECG, blood pressure, SpO₂, weight, contacts.

string.name: consent_data_intro
string.value: Health data is a special category of personal data. FairWear needs your explicit consent to process it. Choose what FairWear may use:

string.name: consent_data_switch_off_note
string.value: A data type you switch off is treated as missing evidence: it lowers coverage and is never counted as zero.

string.name: consent_data_agree_statement
string.value: I consent to FairWear processing the selected health data on this phone to calculate my Health Evidence Score and tier.

string.name: consent_data_withdraw
string.value: You can withdraw this consent at any time by disconnecting HUAWEI Health in FairWear.

string.name: report_view_breaks_one
string.value: 1 suspicious break · one break never flags

string.name: live_card_hr_spoken
string.value: Heart rate now, %s beats per minute

string.name: tour_no_day_sentence
string.value: No day from the watch yet. Pair the watch, close a day on it and sync; this page then shows that day.

string.name: tour_checks_title
string.value: Test the checks on this phone

string.name: tour_checks_sentence
string.value: Each button sends a changed or repeated day through the same checks this phone uses for real days. It works on a copy, so nothing you received is changed.

string.name: tour_real_title
string.value: Real and simulated in this build

string.name: tour_not_observed_summary
string.value: Not observed on %s: %s. Shown as not observed, never as off wrist.

string.name: tour_missing_one
string.value: 1 day is missing and shown as missing.

string.name: tour_missing_many
string.value: %d days are missing and shown as missing.

string.name: partner_page_benefit_no_reason
string.value: %s · The code does not say why.

string.name: share_page_sign_failed
string.value: The code could not be signed: %s

string.name: watchlink_not_linked_sentence
string.value: No watch linked. On the watch, open FairWear and choose Pair phone.

string.name: watchlink_linked_no_days_sentence
string.value: Watch linked. Its first day appears after the watch closes it and syncs.

string.name: watchlink_explained
string.value: The watch signs one summary per day. This phone checks every signature, so a day cannot be edited or removed without it showing.

string.name: watchlink_nothing_observed
string.value: The watch recorded nothing on this day.

string.name: watchlink_missing_explained
string.value: The watch closed this day, but it never reached this phone. It is shown as missing, not as zero.

string.name: watchlink_pair_confirm_hint
string.value: Confirm only if the watch shows the same code.

string.name: watchlink_forget_hint
string.value: Then reset the watch data on the watch and pair again.

string.name: verification_intro
string.value: The technical data behind the Watch link cards: the watch key, sequence numbers, the chain of signed days and the sync log.

string.name: verification_break_from_day_before
string.value: Break from the day before %s–%s · heart-rate slots in the 24 h before: %d

string.name: verification_break
string.value: Break %s–%s · heart-rate slots in the 24 h before: %d
